AWS ENTERPRISE SERVICE AGREEMENT — DEMO FIXTURE
(Fictitious document for DORA AI Analyst testing)

PARTIES
This Agreement is entered into between Banque Démo SA ("the Financial Entity"), a credit institution
authorised under French law, and Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL ("AWS"), registered in Luxembourg.

1. SCOPE OF SERVICES
AWS shall provide the following ICT services to the Financial Entity:
  1.1 Amazon EC2 (compute) — multi-region deployment in eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt).
  1.2 Amazon S3 (object storage) — data residency guaranteed within EU regions.
  1.3 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL — managed database with automated backups (RPO: 1 hour, RTO: 4 hours).
  1.4 Amazon CloudFront (CDN) — edge delivery; data does not leave EU/EEA POP unless explicitly configured.

2. SUBCONTRACTING
AWS may engage third-party sub-processors to deliver parts of the services, including but not limited to:
  - Equinix (data centre colocation in Frankfurt and Dublin)
  - Lumen Technologies (backbone network transit)
AWS will notify the Financial Entity in writing at least 30 days prior to engaging a new sub-processor.

3. DATA LOCATION AND RESIDENCY
All Customer Data shall be processed and stored exclusively within EU/EEA regions as selected by the
Financial Entity. AWS will not transfer Customer Data outside the EU/EEA without prior written consent.
In the event AWS plans to change processing locations, it shall notify the Financial Entity no less than
60 days in advance.

4. DATA PROTECTION AND SECURITY
4.1 AWS implements technical and organisational measures in accordance with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II,
    and the AWS Shared Responsibility Model.
4.2 Data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher. Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256.
4.3 AWS complies with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) as a data processor.
4.4 Availability, integrity, and confidentiality of Customer Data are maintained through redundant
    infrastructure and continuous monitoring.

5. SERVICE LEVELS AND CONTINUITY
5.1 EC2 and RDS availability SLA: 99.99% monthly uptime.
5.2 In the event of an ICT incident affecting availability, AWS will notify the Financial Entity within
    one (1) hour of detection.
5.3 AWS maintains a Business Continuity Plan and Disaster Recovery Plan, which are tested annually.
    Test results are available to the Financial Entity upon request.

6. ACCESS AND AUDIT RIGHTS
6.1 The Financial Entity and its competent authority (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution,
    ACPR) shall have the right to audit AWS's ICT services, subject to 30 days' advance notice.
6.2 AWS shall cooperate fully with such audits and provide relevant documentation.
6.3 AWS will provide annual third-party audit reports (SOC 2 Type II) as evidence of compliance.

7. TERMINATION AND EXIT
7.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement with 90 days' written notice.
7.2 Upon termination, AWS will make Customer Data available for export in standard formats for 30 days.
7.3 AWS will provide reasonable transition assistance to support migration to an alternative provider.

8. INCIDENT REPORTING
AWS shall notify the Financial Entity of any ICT-related incident affecting the availability, authenticity,
integrity, or confidentiality of services within 4 hours of classification as a significant incident.
A full incident report shall be provided within 72 hours.

9. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement is governed by the laws of Luxembourg. Disputes shall be resolved by arbitration under
ICC rules in Paris, France.

SIGNATURES
Signed on behalf of Banque Démo SA: [Director, Digital Operations]
Signed on behalf of Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL: [VP, Enterprise Agreements]
Date: 15 January 2025
